title: The Stilt House
text: A crooked house stands on stilts above the bog, black with damp, a light in its window. The ladder has been pulled up. As you come close the light goes out, and something shifts on the boards overhead.

options.label: Call up to whoever is inside and ask for shelter.

outcomes.text: A family of eel-catchers lets down the ladder. You sleep dry that night.
No one answers. The boards above go very still.

options.label: The quickest shins up a stilt to learn who put out the light.

outcomes.text: The house is empty, a meal still warm on the table. Its window looks out over the road ahead.

options.label: Pass under the house; whoever is up there wants no visitors.

outcomes.text: Something drops from under the floor.
